values.en:
Terminology for basic algebra. The Pointer opens the complete registration module. Native declaration names and full argument indices are preserved; named `english` styles extend, rather than replace, existing upstream defaults.

| Lean constant | Style | Display template |
|---|---|---|
| `Semigroup` | `default` | `#0 has a semigroup structure` |
| `CommSemigroup` | `default` | `#0 has a commutative semigroup structure` |
| `Monoid` | `default` | `#0 has a monoid structure` |
| `CommMonoid` | `default` | `#0 has a commutative monoid structure` |
| `Group` | `default` | `#0 has a group structure` |
| `CommGroup` | `default` | `#0 has a commutative group structure` |
| `AddSemigroup` | `default` | `#0 has an additive semigroup structure` |
| `AddCommSemigroup` | `default` | `#0 has a commutative additive semigroup structure` |
| `AddMonoid` | `default` | `#0 has an additive monoid structure` |
| `AddCommMonoid` | `default` | `#0 has a commutative additive monoid structure` |
| `AddGroup` | `default` | `#0 has an additive group structure` |
| `AddCommGroup` | `default` | `#0 has a commutative additive group structure` |
| `Semiring` | `default` | `#0 has a semiring structure` |
| `Ring` | `default` | `#0 has a ring structure` |
| `CommRing` | `default` | `#0 has a commutative ring structure` |
| `Field` | `default` | `#0 has a field structure` |
| `Units` | `default` | `units of #0` |
| `MonoidHom` | `default` | `multiplication- and identity-preserving maps from #0 to #1` |
| `RingHom` | `default` | `addition-, multiplication-, zero-, and identity-preserving maps from #0 to #1` |
